en_title: Take-Two Appears to Be Trying to Scrub GTA 6 PC Ports From the Internet, as Vibecoders Race Toward Controversial World First
cn_title: 随着氛围编程者竞逐引发争议的全球首个移植版本，Take-Two似乎正试图从互联网上清除《GTA 6》PC移植版
opus_summary: 据报道，Take-Two通过DMCA下架通知促使GitHub删除了与《GTA 6》非官方PC移植有关的3007个代码仓库。其他类似项目仍在进行，部分已接近实现一定程度的可玩性。Take-Two负责人表示，公司正加强技术防御和法律行动。

paragraphs.en: Take-Two appears to be taking on the many GTA 6 PC ports currently in the works following Cyberleek’s alleged release of an unauthorized Xbox build of the game.
paragraphs.cn: 据称Cyberleek发布了未经授权的《GTA 6》XBOX构建版本后，Take-Two似乎正对付目前开发中的众多《GTA 6》PC移植版本。

paragraphs.en: This week, Cyberleek allegedly released the executable file for the incomplete GTA 6 Xbox build they reportedly leaked the week prior, sparking a race within the homebrew scene to port the build to PC. There’s even a website tracking the various attempts to recompile, emulate, or port the leaked Xbox Series build to PC.
paragraphs.cn: 本周，Cyberleek据称发布了不完整的《GTA 6》XBOX构建版本的可执行文件；据报道，这一构建版本是其在前一周泄露的。这引发了自制软件社区内将该构建版本移植至PC的竞赛。甚至还有一个网站追踪各种将泄露的XBOX Series构建版本重新编译、模拟或移植至PC的尝试。

paragraphs.en: But it looks like Take-Two is taking action, reportedly convincing GitHub to delete an entire network of 3,007 repositories via a DMCA takedown notice.
paragraphs.cn: 但Take-Two似乎正在采取行动，据报道，该公司通过一份DMCA下架通知说服GitHub删除了一个包含3,007个仓库的完整网络。

paragraphs.en: The takedown we know about relates to ItsNotRexed's GitHub repository and the over 2,900 forks attached to it, which Take-Two said facilitated copyright infringement of GTA 6. Take-Two alleged that the repository Project Leonida repository "exceeds the license Rockstar Games grants to users, constituting copyright infringement.” Here, Take-Two claimed that the repository violated at least Section 2.3 of Rockstar Games’ terms of service:
paragraphs.cn: 我们所知的这次下架涉及ItsNotRexed的GitHub仓库及其附属的2,900多个分叉仓库，Take-Two表示，这些仓库助长了对《GTA 6》版权的侵犯。Take-Two指称，Project Leonida仓库「超出了Rockstar授予用户的许可范围，构成版权侵权」。在此，Take-Two声称该仓库至少违反了Rockstar服务条款的第2.3节：

paragraphs.en: Additionally, there’s an interesting note in the takedown order that addresses the “bring your own files” defence we’ve seen so often from the homebrew community when it comes to unofficial ports of video games. As you’d expect, Take-Two isn’t in favor of it, insisting that in this case, the files the user must provide come from the unauthorized GTA 6 Xbox build Cyberleek leaked online.
paragraphs.cn: 此外，下架通知中有一条值得注意的说明，针对的是自制软件社区在涉及电子游戏非官方移植版时常用的「自带文件」辩护。正如人们所料，Take-Two并不赞同这一说法，坚持认为在本案中，用户必须提供的文件来自Cyberleek泄露到网上的未经授权的《GTA 6》XBOX构建版本。

paragraphs.en: IGN has asked Take-Two for comment.
paragraphs.cn: IGN已向Take-Two请求置评。

paragraphs.en: According to now deleted social media posts, NotRexed, author of the Leonida project, shut it down entirely. There are also screenshots of its Discord showing users posting disclaimers distancing themselves from Project Leonida in case of a federal investigation.
paragraphs.cn: 根据现已删除的社交媒体帖子，Leonida项目的作者NotRexed已将其彻底关闭。还有该项目Discord的截图显示，用户发布免责声明，与Project Leonida撇清关系，以防联邦调查。

paragraphs.en: However, many similar projects remain active, risking similar action from Take-Two. Seemingly undeterred, these projects are ongoing, with some getting close to creating a PC port of GTA 6 that is somewhat playable. Some are even streaming their efforts, showing how they are vibecoding a port using agent prompts such as "make no mistakes," "keep finding more stuff and working and pushing," and "work faster."
paragraphs.cn: 然而，许多类似项目仍在活跃，面临Take-Two采取类似行动的风险。这些项目似乎没有受到阻挠，仍在继续，其中一些已接近制作出勉强可以游玩的《GTA 6》PC移植版。有些人甚至直播自己的工作，展示他们如何使用「不要犯错」「继续寻找更多东西，不断工作和推进」以及「工作快一点」等智能体提示词，以氛围编程方式制作移植版。

paragraphs.en: This is of course a nightmare scenario for Take-Two and Sony and Microsoft, which are benefiting greatly from GTA 6 releasing on console only. The console version of GTA 6 targets 30fps across all platforms, although struggles at times to hit that on base PS5, and Xbox Series X and S. As a result, there is huge interest in a potential PC version offering 60fps gameplay.
paragraphs.cn: 这对Take-Two、索尼和微软来说当然是一场噩梦，因为它们正从《GTA 6》仅在主机上发布中获得巨大利益。《GTA 6》主机版在所有平台上的目标均为30fps，但在标准版PS5以及XBOX Series X和S上有时难以达到这一帧率。因此，人们对可能提供60fps游戏体验的PC版抱有极大兴趣。

paragraphs.en: As you've probably seen from various viral clips on social media, people are using AI to create clones of popular games and release them on platforms they're not normally available on. We've seen everything from Minecraft playable inside X/Twitter to modders crashing Minecraft and Elden Ring together . Indeed, last month, Rockstar's own Grand Theft Auto 5 was made playable in a browser before it was pulled offline.
paragraphs.cn: 你可能已经从社交媒体上各种广泛传播的短片中看到，人们正在使用AI制作热门游戏的克隆版，并将其发布到通常无法玩到这些游戏的平台上。从可以在X中游玩的《我的世界》，到模组制作者将《我的世界》和《艾尔登法环》混合在一起，各种例子我们都见过。事实上，就在上个月，Rockstar自己的《侠盗猎车手5》被制成了可在浏览器中游玩的版本，随后被下线。

paragraphs.en: Seemingly in response, Anthropic issued an update for Claude that made it harder for people to use the AI model to generate video game clones. In an interview with IGN sister site RPS , former Rockstar North technical director Obbe Vermeij said that Rockstar Games may be keen to port GTA 6 to PC as soon as possible , due to the explosion of AI-generated clones and ports.
paragraphs.cn: Anthropic似乎为此发布了Claude更新，使人们更难使用这一AI模型生成电子游戏克隆版。在接受IGN姊妹网站RPS采访时，Rockstar North前技术总监Obbe Vermeij表示，由于AI生成的克隆版和移植版大量涌现，Rockstar可能急于尽快将《GTA 6》移植至PC。

paragraphs.en: Some of this concern has to do with the security of the PS5, with Sony seemingly engaged in a game of Whac-a-Mole with hackers who are trying to jailbreak the latest firmware. If a PS5 jailbreak is made available for the firmware that is required by GTA 6 to run, it may be possible for Rockstar’s game to be pirated on PS5 and subsequently made available on PC.
paragraphs.cn: 部分担忧与PS5的安全性有关，索尼似乎正与试图破解最新固件的黑客展开一场打地鼠式的较量。如果运行《GTA 6》所需的固件出现了可用的PS5破解方法，Rockstar的游戏就有可能在PS5上遭到盗版，并随后被移植到PC上。

paragraphs.en: Earlier this month, Strauss Zelnick, the boss of Take-Two, responded to the threat of AI-assisted reverse-engineering and decompilation of games in an interview with IGN. He said he was taking the issue seriously, and insisted that fans will prefer to play GTA 6 officially, with all its bells and whistles as Rockstar intended, over an unofficial PC version.
paragraphs.cn: 本月早些时候，Take-Two老板Strauss Zelnick在接受IGN采访时回应了AI辅助游戏逆向工程和反编译带来的威胁。他表示自己正在认真对待这一问题，并坚称比起非官方PC版本，粉丝会更愿意游玩官方版《GTA 6》，体验Rockstar所设想的全部丰富内容。

paragraphs.en: IGN: We've seen hackers using AI to clone games much faster than ever before, even try to jailbreak consoles. And there is some concern about this leading to potentially GTA 6 being made available on PC unofficially or places that you aren't releasing it. I was just wondering how much of a threat this is to your business? And, is there anything meaningful you can do about it?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：我们看到黑客利用AI以前所未有的速度克隆游戏，甚至尝试破解主机。有人担心这可能导致《GTA 6》被非官方地发布到PC或你们未发布该游戏的平台上。我想问问，这对你们的业务构成了多大的威胁？另外，你们能否采取任何有意义的措施来应对？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I don't think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It's important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions. And at the same time, of course, we protect our intellectual property vigilantly. So we are focused on these concerns. We're not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. And at the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：就对我们业务的威胁而言，我不认为这是一个财务问题。我确实认为这是一个创作问题。呈现Rockstar设想的体验，对所有人都很重要，无论是我们的开发者还是消费者。同时，我们当然会警惕地保护自己的知识产权。因此，我们关注这些问题，绝没有丝毫掉以轻心。技术正在快速发展。与此同时，我确实认为几乎所有人都希望获得Rockstar所设想的Rockstar体验。

paragraphs.en: IGN: Related, last week Anthropic confirmed they took steps to block Claude from reverse engineering video games. I would assume you would welcome that. And would you like to see other AI companies like OpenAI do the same thing to prevent people from using these powerful AI models to clone your games?
paragraphs.cn: IGN：与此相关的是，上周Anthropic确认已采取措施，阻止Claude对电子游戏进行逆向工程。我想你应该会对此表示欢迎。你是否希望看到OpenAI等其他AI公司也采取同样的措施，防止人们使用这些强大的AI模型克隆你们的游戏？

paragraphs.en: Strauss Zelnick: I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's. And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected.
paragraphs.cn: Strauss Zelnick：我认为所有公司都应该保护知识产权，包括自己的和其他所有人的。如果你从事的是知识产权业务，Anthropic和OpenAI都是如此，那么一方面践踏别人的知识产权，另一方面又希望自己的知识产权受到保护，这似乎很讽刺。

paragraphs.en: During an investor-focused Q&A following the release of Take-Two’s latest financial report, attended by IGN, Zelnick was asked multiple times about the AI reverse-engineering problem. He, again, had strong words in response, suggesting Take-Two was ready to lawyer up.
paragraphs.cn: 在Take-Two发布最新财报后举行的一场面向投资者的问答会上，Zelnick多次被问及AI逆向工程问题，IGN也参加了这场问答会。他再次以强硬措辞作出回应，暗示Take-Two已准备好诉诸法律。

paragraphs.en: “This business has been largely immune to piracy concerns forever because of file sizes, complexity of piracy, being connected to servers and the like,” he began. “And undoubtedly, it would be very difficult to replicate the experience of consuming our game as intended because of technical limitations.
paragraphs.cn: 他首先表示：「一直以来，由于文件大小、盗版的复杂性、连接服务器等因素，这个行业基本不受盗版问题的影响。毫无疑问，受技术限制，要复制按我们设想的方式体验游戏的感受将非常困难。

paragraphs.en: “That said, it's going to become more of a challenge, as you said, and we're aware of that. So we are utterly focused on enhancing our technical defenses and enhancing our legal activities appropriately. And at the same time, without in any way being cavalier, every entertainment business that exists is subject to some element of piracy. So this is likely to invade our business to a greater or lesser extent. I think it will be manageable and we are focused on it.”
paragraphs.cn: 「话虽如此，正如你所说，这将成为一个更大的挑战，我们也意识到了这一点。因此，我们正全力加强技术防御，并适当地加强法律行动。同时，我绝不是在掉以轻心，但所有现存的娱乐行业都在某种程度上受到盗版影响。因此，这很可能会或多或少地侵入我们的业务。我认为这将是可控的，我们正关注这一问题。」

paragraphs.en: Zelnick’s talk about legal activities sparks an obvious question: what can game companies do about AI-assisted reverse engineering? It's a question IGN recently asked when people started to work on a PC port of Nintendo Switch 2 exclusive, The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time remake .
paragraphs.cn: Zelnick谈及法律行动，引出了一个显而易见的问题：游戏公司能如何应对AI辅助的逆向工程？最近，当人们开始制作Switch 2独占作品《塞尔达传说 时之笛》重制版的PC移植版时，IGN就提出过这个问题。
